threshold_note: All thresholds are coach heuristics tuned on recorded matches (rec3, rec5), not game rules. Distances are minimap fractions (map width = 1). An unread value never counts as safe or as evidence. fight_far starts where the positioning coach's help/join calls end (help_max_distance 0.45), so the two never describe the same fight.
r8_calls_note: exit_*: deep in their half (y < exit_y, or their base label) while two or more enemies are back within exit_back_secs (top-bar respawn timers, or respawned in the last exit_recent_secs), or exit_unseen enemies are unseen, with fewer than exit_allies_near teammates within exit_ally_radius (rec8 20:14, 27:39, 39:00; rec13 40:33). ult_*: your ultimate (ability slot 4) on cooldown in their half (y < ult_half_y) with ult_unseen enemies unseen. escape_*: your escape ability (escapes below, e.g. Grey Talon's Rain of Arrows in slot 2) cast fresh (ready shortly before, then a cooldown read at or above escape_fresh_cd) at y < escape_y with escape_missing enemies unseen or just back (rec8 16:54, 20:27). Both need you without two teammates beside you and no window open (fewer than two enemies dead on longer timers): rec8 cast Rain of Arrows ten times in their half, eight of them in a won fight or a window. forward_min_clock: not in the laning phase, where most enemies are unseen in their lanes (rec13 10:35). The enemy-dead window names only a lane you reach before it closes (positioning::TRAVEL_SECS_PER_MAP, a coach estimate; rec8 29:41 / 31:11 said Yellow from Blue with 17-19 s left).
escapes_note: Escape abilities by hero and HUD slot (slot 4 is the ultimate). On the wiki Grey Talon's Rain of Arrows is ability 2 and Guided Owl is the ultimate.

source.section: ## Grey Talon: Rain of Arrows (ability 2) and Guided Owl (ultimate)
source.excerpt: Cancelling Rain of Arrows while rising keeps the launch momentum, which can be used for mobility and evasion.

new_calls_note: loss_*: two ally deaths on the top bar within 15 s, with the fight (an enemy marker within 0.15 of an allied one) more than 0.3 map away from you (rec8 34:46-34:52). hold_*: walking out of base, or still in it, while three teammates are dead on timers of 8 s or more or unread (rec8 41:50), or two teammates respawn within 15 s (rec8 48:07). raid_*: two enemy heroes inside the bottom-centre base region of the minimap, or your structure's health banner, while you are not in base. urn_*: carrying the urn with two teammates dead and an enemy within 0.2 (rec8 27:12-27:39).
killers_note: Per-hero advice for a repeat killer. Items are class names from data/items.json; the first affordable one not owned is suggested, else the cheapest not owned. Victor's Aura and Drifter's Stalker's Mark / Rend are spirit damage over time that 'can be dispelled' (deadlock.wiki).
roles_note: Only heroes whose range is stated on their deadlock.wiki page are listed; unlisted heroes get no range advice.

source.excerpt: harasses his enemies with arrows and spirit from long range

close_sources_note: Death-panel sources that only hit you up close (wiki: the aura has an 8m radius; Rend deals bonus melee damage in close range).
generic_sources_note: Death-panel rows that name no single hero; never attributed.

cards.speech: Back out of {hero}'s Aura of Suffering now. It ramps up the longer you stay.
cards.rationale: The debuff badge proves you are inside the 8m aura; its damage ramps up while you stay.

sources.excerpt: The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Get too close and risk getting caught in his Aura of Suffering

cards.speech: Stand next to a teammate: {hero}'s Stalker's Mark is on you. Keep your escape.
cards.rationale: A marked, isolated hero is Drifter's ideal target: the mark lets him teleport behind you and Bloodscent amplifies damage on isolated heroes.

sources.excerpt: While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes

cards.speech: Escape the moment the stun ends. You're dropping fast.
cards.rationale: A stun while health falls means you are being focused; the escape held in reserve is what saves you.

sources.excerpt: hold defense for when focused
Debuff Reducer/Dispel Magic/Divine Barrier vs DoT or CC

cards.speech: Back behind cover until the silence ends. You're dropping fast.
cards.rationale: Without abilities you cannot trade back; leaving the fight until the silence ends avoids a one-sided exchange.

sources.excerpt: hold defense for when focused
Weapon heroes avoid walking into control for one extra shot

cards.speech: Knocked off the zipline: get to cover and back to us.
cards.rationale: Being knocked off a zipline drops you where the enemy chose to fight, usually alone.

sources.excerpt: Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: {count} of them are dead for {secs} more seconds: {target} now.
cards.rationale: Greyed enemy portraits with long timers are a numbers advantage; on your own half with good health, the lane you are on (else the nearest one you reach before the window closes) and its next standing enemy structure convert it. The count is the heroes dead for the whole window.

sources.excerpt: count survivors and take the highest-value safe action (objective, wave, reset) rather than chasing

sources.section: ## 10. Chasing kills instead of taking objectives
sources.excerpt: They are dead. Take the Walker now.

cards.speech: You're in base holding {souls} souls. Spend them before you walk out.
cards.rationale: The base shop is the safe moment to buy; walking out unspent takes the fight without that power.

sources.excerpt: Do not hoard souls through fights; buy during respawn or at the base.
Spend steadily and stay alive; hoarding for one expensive item while dying is a trap (metabot).

cards.speech: You're heading out at {pct}% health. Heal in base first; it's fast.
cards.rationale: Shopping does not heal; base regeneration does, quickly.

sources.excerpt: Standing in base will quickly regenerate the player's health (adding +60 health per second and +6% of max health per second), allowing them to recover from fights.

cards.speech: You carry {souls} unsecured souls {why}. Back off until they secure.
cards.rationale: Haunted souls are lost on death; they convert over time, so surviving the next seconds keeps them.

sources.excerpt: haunted souls are lost on death and drop in a Soul Bag only above 50 + 5/min.
Haunted souls convert to secured at 0.5%/s of the current haunted total plus a flat base

cards.speech: {killer}'s {ability} topped {count} of your deaths. {tip}{item}.
cards.rationale: The same enemy doing the most damage in several deaths is a pattern to answer with positioning and one defensive item.

sources.excerpt: dying repeatedly to same damage type
defense if one pattern kills you
DoT heroes -> debuff removers

cards.speech: {count} of your deaths came up close. You're a long-range hero: fight from max range behind our front line.
cards.rationale: A long-range hero dying mostly to melee and close-range damage is fighting at the enemy's range.

sources.excerpt: He uses traps and brief flight to maintain his distance
damage dealers behind with escape lanes; do not stand in front of your tank

cards.speech: We're fighting {allies} on {enemies} at {area} without you. Rotate now if your wave is safe.
cards.rationale: A team fight on the minimap far from you is fought a hero short.

sources.excerpt: A fight entered with team split or a teammate still walking from base is usually lost (metabot).
Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: {action}: {count} teammates are dead{next}. Don't walk out alone.
cards.rationale: With three teammates on respawn timers the map is lost for that time; walking out alone is a free kill and a longer timer.

sources.excerpt: A fight entered with team split or a teammate still walking from base is usually lost (metabot).

sources.excerpt: A fight entered with team split or a teammate still walking from base is usually lost (metabot).

cards.speech: Don't go in alone: we're losing at {area}. {count} teammates died in {secs} seconds.
cards.rationale: Two teammates falling within seconds of each other far from you is a lost fight; arriving alone adds a third death.

sources.section: ## 19. Engaging without an advantage / continuing after opener whiffs
sources.excerpt: Fight is lost. Retreat together.
Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: Go defend our {structure}: it's under attack.

sources.excerpt: Dying late is expensive: long respawns, and an enemy Patron kill ends the game.

cards.speech: Go defend our base: {count} enemies are inside it.
cards.rationale: Enemy heroes on the minimap inside your base while you farm elsewhere are sieging structures your team cannot lose.

sources.excerpt: Dying late is expensive: long respawns, and an enemy Patron kill ends the game.

cards.speech: Hold the urn: {count} teammates are dead and an enemy is close. Back off and wait for them.
cards.rationale: The courier cannot parry or zipline and drops the urn to a melee hit or stun; without teammates to escort, an enemy beside you takes it.

sources.excerpt: Courier cannot use ziplines, teleporters, parry. Melee hits and stuns force a drop.

cards.speech: Out of their base: {who} {is_are} back {when}.
cards.rationale: The enemy-dead window closes while you are deep in their half: the heroes coming back spawn in their base, between you and your team (rec8 20:14, 27:39, 39:00; the last warning used to come 2.5 s before those deaths).

sources.excerpt: Don't throw a won game by chasing one last kill into the enemy base - take the objective, then reset.

cards.speech: Out of their base: {count} of them are unseen and you're deep.
cards.rationale: Deep in their half with most of their team off the map and no teammate beside you, they choose the next fight (rec13 40:33: five unseen, dead at 41:05).

sources.excerpt: Don't throw a won game by chasing one last kill into the enemy base - take the objective, then reset.
